key_insight: CI-PINN adds a causal Volterra-type integral module to PINNs so temporal dependence is built into the network architecture for better evolution-equation solving.
engineering_relevance: This makes PINN-based PDE solvers more accurate and robust, especially when training data are sparse in space-time.
method: Introduce CinNet with a causal integral term that aggregates historical features.
Build CI-PINN on top of CinNet to enforce physics-informed learning for evolution equations.
Use the causal architecture to encode temporal causality directly, instead of relying only on loss-level tricks.
evidence_signal: Benchmark experiments on evolution equations show better solution accuracy than baseline PINN variants, with especially strong gains under sparse-collocation settings.
watch_item: The causal integral module adds architectural complexity, so performance may depend on careful discretization and implementation of the history aggregation.
paper_title: CI-PINN: Causal Integral Physics-Informed Neural Network for Solving Evolution Equations
